title: Let a studio create a draft invoice
body:
## Value
Studios write invoices in the app.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A draft invoice with lines saves with the next free number
- [ ] Two drafts never share a number

## Notes
Task 1. Plan the task before building. Epic: docs/plans/v1/02-invoices.md

title: Email an invoice to the client
body:
## Value
Clients get invoices without the studio exporting them.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Send emails the client a link to the invoice
- [ ] A sent invoice can no longer be edited

## Notes
Task 2, depends on task 1. Plan the task before building. Epic: docs/plans/v1/02-invoices.md

title: Mark an invoice paid
body:
## Value
Studios see what is still owed.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The studio marks an invoice paid
- [ ] The list shows paid and unpaid apart

## Notes
Task 3, depends on task 1. Plan the task before building. Epic: docs/plans/v1/02-invoices.md

title: Download an invoice as PDF
body:
## Value
Studios attach invoices to their bookkeeping.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Download gives a PDF with the invoice's lines and total
- [ ] The file name holds the invoice number

## Notes
Task 4, depends on task 1. Plan the task before building. Epic: docs/plans/v1/02-invoices.md
